meta.note: Historical events sourced from Wikipedia. Events 2026+ are speculative forecasts framed astrologically.

kinds.bad: Occurred while barycenter was OUTSIDE the Sun (shadow phase).
kinds.good: Occurred while barycenter was INSIDE the Sun (light phase).
kinds.equilibrium: Occurred within a year of a moment when the barycenter passed through the Sun's center.

events.title: Napoleonic Wars escalate
events.blurb: France resumes war against the United Kingdom, opening a decade of continental conflict.

events.title: Napoleon crowns himself Emperor
events.blurb: Coronation at Notre-Dame consolidates autocratic rule across Europe.

events.title: Great Comet of 1811
events.blurb: Sun and barycenter nearly coincide. A comet visible for 260 days becomes a global omen.

events.title: First scheduled steamboat service
events.blurb: The Comet begins service on the Clyde, opening the age of powered transport.

events.title: Battle of Waterloo
events.blurb: Napoleon's final defeat closes a quarter-century of European war — through immense loss.

events.title: Year Without a Summer
events.blurb: Tambora's eruption darkens skies worldwide; crop failure and famine follow.

events.title: Stockton–Darlington Railway opens
events.blurb: The first public railway to use steam locomotives launches the rail age.

events.title: Erie Canal opens
events.blurb: New York links the Atlantic to the Great Lakes, remaking American geography.

events.title: Faraday's electromagnetic induction published
events.blurb: The principle behind every generator and motor enters the record.

events.title: Slavery Abolition Act (UK)
events.blurb: Britain outlaws slavery across most of the Empire.

events.title: Great Famine begins in Ireland
events.blurb: Potato blight triggers a decade of starvation, death, and diaspora.

events.title: Revolutions of 1848
events.blurb: Uprisings sweep Europe; most are crushed within a year.

events.title: The barycenter passes through the Sun's center
events.blurb: A rare stillness before the storms of mid-century.

events.title: The Great Exhibition opens in London
events.blurb: The Crystal Palace celebrates industry, invention, and international exchange.

events.title: Crimean War widens
events.blurb: Britain and France declare war on Russia; siege of Sevastopol follows.

events.title: American Civil War begins
events.blurb: Four years of war leave over 600,000 dead.

events.title: First transcontinental railroad completed
events.blurb: The Golden Spike joins North America coast to coast.

events.title: Suez Canal opens
events.blurb: The Mediterranean and Red Sea are joined; the world grows smaller.

events.title: First telephone call
events.blurb: Alexander Graham Bell transmits speech electrically.

events.title: Great Famine of 1876–1878
events.blurb: Drought and colonial policy kill millions across India and China.

events.title: Krakatoa erupts
events.blurb: One of the loudest events in recorded history; tsunamis kill tens of thousands.

events.title: Kodak camera introduced
events.blurb: "You press the button — we do the rest." Photography becomes democratic.

events.title: New Zealand grants women the vote
events.blurb: The first self-governing country to enact universal women's suffrage.

events.title: Spanish–American War
events.blurb: A short war marks the emergence of a new imperial power.

events.title: Russo-Japanese War begins
events.blurb: The first major conflict of the 20th century between industrial powers.

events.title: Tunguska event witnessed
events.blurb: A vast blast in Siberian sky — no casualties, only awe.

events.title: Ford Model T introduced
events.blurb: Mass mobility enters ordinary life.

events.title: Panama Canal opens
events.blurb: The Atlantic and Pacific are joined by human hands — days after Europe went to war.

events.title: Battle of Verdun begins
events.blurb: Ten months of trench warfare kill roughly 300,000 — the shadow phase of the Great War.

events.title: Spanish flu pandemic
events.blurb: A global influenza kills an estimated 50 million.

events.title: Wall Street Crash (paradox)
events.blurb: Even in the light phase the market broke — a reminder the sky is not fate.

events.title: Penicillin discovered
events.blurb: Alexander Fleming's mould begins the antibiotic era.

events.title: Second World War begins
events.blurb: Germany invades Poland. Six years of total war follow.

events.title: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
events.blurb: A new order of destructive power enters history.

events.title: Universal Declaration of Human Rights
events.blurb: The UN adopts a shared vision of dignity for all.

events.title: The barycenter returns to the Sun's center
events.blurb: The world briefly steadies between two nuclear rivals.

events.title: Structure of DNA published
events.blurb: Watson, Crick, Franklin, and Wilkins reveal the double helix.

events.title: Cuban Missile Crisis
events.blurb: The world stands closer to nuclear war than at any other moment.

events.title: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon
events.blurb: Humans walk on another world for the first time.

events.title: Apollo–Soyuz Test Project
events.blurb: American and Soviet spacecraft dock — a handshake in orbit.

events.title: Iran–Iraq War begins
events.blurb: An eight-year war leaves over a million casualties.

events.title: Nelson Mandela released
events.blurb: After 27 years in prison, Mandela walks free; the end of apartheid becomes possible.

events.title: Chernobyl disaster
events.blurb: A reactor explodes; a plume of caesium crosses Europe.

events.title: The Berlin Wall falls
events.blurb: The Cold War's most visible boundary comes down.

events.title: The barycenter passes through the Sun's center
events.blurb: The Iron Curtain has just fallen; the world exhales.

events.title: World Wide Web goes public
events.blurb: Tim Berners-Lee's project opens to anyone with a modem.

events.title: Rwandan genocide
events.blurb: In 100 days, an estimated 800,000 Tutsi and moderate Hutu are killed.

events.title: September 11 attacks
events.blurb: Nearly 3,000 killed; a new century's shape is set.

events.title: Human Genome Project completed
events.blurb: The full human sequence is published in the public domain.

events.title: Global Financial Crisis
events.blurb: Lehman Brothers collapses. A cascade of failure spreads worldwide.

events.title: Higgs boson discovered
events.blurb: CERN confirms the particle that gives matter its mass.

events.title: Paris Climate Agreement
events.blurb: 196 parties commit to limit warming — the first truly universal climate accord.

events.title: COVID-19 declared a pandemic
events.blurb: A coronavirus rewrites life for years.

events.title: Russia invades Ukraine
events.blurb: The largest land war in Europe since 1945 begins.

events.title: AI accelerates, geopolitics fracture
events.blurb: The shadow phase deepens; institutions strain under new pressures.

events.title: The barycenter meets the Sun again
events.blurb: A predicted moment of astrological stillness — draw a breath.

events.title: Forecast: a decade of repair
events.blurb: The light phase invites healing — climate, health, cooperation.

events.title: Forecast: the middle century shadow
events.blurb: A long outside-phase suggests turbulence — prepare, do not despair.

events.title: Forecast: a second age of exploration
events.blurb: Extended light phase — inward and outward journeys favored.

events.title: Forecast: the 22nd century opens in shadow
events.blurb: Barycenter remains outside — a call to institutions that outlast us.

events.title: The deepest equilibrium of the era
events.blurb: The barycenter passes within 16,000 km of the Sun's exact center.

events.title: Another near-perfect alignment
events.blurb: A moment as still as any in four centuries.

events.title: Forecast: a long light phase closes
events.blurb: Twelve luminous years give way to shadow — carry forward what was built.
